name: io.github.pebois.gnome-ai-chat
description: A simple chat application for GNOME built with JavaScript (GJS), Gtk4, and Libadwaita. It communicates with the Ollama HTTP API.

scripts.flatpak-cache: mkdir -p /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache && cp package.json package-lock.json /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache/ && npm install --prefix /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache --cache /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache/cache && tar czf .npm-cache.tar.gz -C /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache --transform 's/cache/npm-cache/' cache && rm -rf /tmp/npm-flatpak-cache
scripts.extension-install: npm run extension-build && mkdir -p ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-chat@pebois.github.io/schemas && cp extension/metadata.json extension/extension.js ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-chat@pebois.github.io/ && cp extension/schemas/*.xml ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-chat@pebois.github.io/schemas/ && glib-compile-schemas ~/.local/share/gnome-shell/extensions/gnome-ai-chat@pebois.github.io/schemas/

author: Pierre-Emmanuel Bois
